title: ToMATO: Verbalizing the Mental States of Role-Playing LLMs for Benchmarking Theory of Mind

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the model's Theory of Mind (ToM) question-answering performance across characters assigned different Big Five personality traits (high vs. low Openness, Conscientiousness, Extraversion, Agreeableness, and Neuroticism) to test if performance degrades for specific personality types.

Conducting z-statistics analysis and evaluating a lexical overlap baseline to determine if models rely on word-level spurious correlations or shortcut artifacts rather than genuine Theory of Mind reasoning.
